purpose: Evaluate the leading fourth geographic stratum for the preregistered balanced global oceanic-island ABM validation sample without inspecting ABM fit.
why_not_admitted_yet: The article establishes quantitative interaction sampling and two oceanic-arc islands, but the site-level interaction matrices must be source-locked and mapped to the current network target schema before either island enters leave-one-island ABM validation.
selection_boundary: This source was selected because it fills the preregistered Caribbean geographic gap with two independently located island systems under one standardized field design; no ABM outcome was inspected.
next_gate: Recover the five source matrices or an author/institutional data artifact, preserve Dominica and Grenada as separate island systems while clustering them by study, then test whether the preregistered minimum of four strata x two systems is met.
